caption: The drawing consists of a square composition featuring layered borders and a central decorative motif. The outermost border is composed of wide bands, with alternating sections of yellow, pink, and blue, separated by brown lines. Inside this is a thick brown border, followed by a wavy-edged pink border that frames the central area. Within the central pink area, there is a stylized depiction of a plant: a brown stem with several teal-green leaves and three white triangular clusters, each dotted with brown spots, resembling bunches of grapes. The composition is centered on a beige background, and the number "17" appears in blue at the lower left corner.
title: Plate 17: Grapes, Altar Panel: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
